token.title: 🔑 Tokeni ya GitHub
token.intro: GitHub yishura ubusabe 60 ku isaha buvuye kuri aderese itarungika tokeni. Igiti ca fork cose gitwara nka 32, rero ku ncuro ya kabiri birahera. Tokeni iduza urubibe rukagera 5000 ku isaha.
token.step1: Ugurure Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, hanyuma Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: konti yawe bwite. Iherezo: itariki iyo ari yo yose, igiti nta kintu kimara igihe kirekire gikeneye.
token.step4: Ntukore ku ruhusha na rumwe. Amakuru y'ububiko rusangi nta na rumwe muri zo akeneye.
token.step5: Rema, hanyuma ukoporore agaciro ka {token}. GitHub ikerekana rimwe gusa.
token.classic: Tokeni ya kera nayo irakora: yirema utatoye scope na kimwe. Scope itagira ico irimwo iracasoma amakuru rusangi ku muvuduko w'abemejwe.
token.stays: Iguma muri iyi mucukumbuzi munsi y'urufunguzo {key} kandi ija kuri {host} gusa. Ntiyandikwa na rimwe mu kibanza c'aderese, rero umurongo usangiye utwara ishusho atari ivyangombwa vyo kwinjira. Buto iri munsi y'ikibanza irayifuta hamwe n'ububiko bw'agateganyo.
token.persistHow: Shira tokeni mu dosiye {env} ya seriveri yakira uru rupapuro, iruhande rwa {port}:
token.proxy: hanyuma uyitangure na {make}. Kontineri ica yandika agace ka nginx gashira umutwe {header} kuri proxy ya {path}, rero mucukumbuzi ihamagara inkomoko yayo bwite kandi ntironka tokeni na rimwe. Iki kibanza kirazimangana kandi abashitsi bose basangira ingengo imwe ya 5000 ku isaha.
fork.refused404: Nta mirongo y'amashami: {message}. 404 ng'aha ni ishami ritabaho canke inzira proxy ya seriveri idatwara; uko biri kwose, urusobe rwa fork ruri hejuru rurunganye.
fork.refusedExhausted: GitHub yaheze ubusabe bw'iyi saha, rero nta mirongo y'amashami yashoboye gushushanywa. Urusobe rwa fork ruri hejuru rurunganye. Ongeramwo tokeni mu gice c'akayunguruzo, canke uzimye imirongo y'amashami mu gice c'isura kugira ingengo ikoreshwe ku rusobe gusa.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub yishuye {status} ku kahise k'amahinduka, rero nta mirongo y'amashami yashoboye gushushanywa. Urusobe rwa fork ruri hejuru rurunganye.
